newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Earnings hopes push MOL to new high.
newsitem.headline: Earnings hopes push MOL to new high.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian oil and gas company MOL added more than five percent to Friday's eight percent gain as they rose to record territory on Monday on market talk of good annual results, traders said.
MOL shares opened at 2,995 forints and rose to a new record high of 3,290 forints.
At 1144 GMT MOL stood at 3,275 forints, up 195 from Friday's close. By this time more than 400,000 MOL shares changed hands.
"The market expects very good results from MOL," one trader said.
Hungarian companies have to release their preliminary annual results by February 15.
MOL said on Friday morning that it had agreed with trade unions to raise base wages by an average 17 percent in 1997.
MOL and the trade unions also agreed to provide employees with a one-off share package worth half of average monthly base wages.
